data.narrative:
Improbable Defence is a Growth-stage defense and security company that has raised $703M to date. The broader Defense & Security sector includes 10 comparable companies (2 public, 8 private), though a sufficiently deep peer set at identical stage and valuation tier within this vertical proved unavailable for traditional multiples-based analysis.

Stage-progression methodology was the applicable triangulation approach. Using total capital raised ($703M) as a proxy for current valuation and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement, this method implies a valuation of $844M. The 1.2x multiplier reflects expected value creation between the current funding stage and subsequent institutional rounds, absent company-specific performance data.

Given the single applicable method and limited narrow peer density in Defense & Security at comparable scale, the analysis supports a valuation range of $717M (conservative floor) to $970M (upside case), with a median point of $844M. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct same-stage comparables in the sector, which limits cross-validation; actual valuation will depend on revenue run-rate, customer concentration, and technology differentiation relative to Anduril Industries, Helsing, and other named peers in the space.
